segments.title: The animal that never forgets!
segments.say: Meet the animal that never forgets, with Kwan from Chiang Mai, Thailand!

segments.title: Huge, grey, long trunk. Guess!
segments.say: A clue: it is huge, grey, and has a long trunk. Can you guess it?

segments.title: It's the elephant!
segments.say: It's the elephant! They have amazing memories.

segments.title: Three elephant facts
segments.say: They're the biggest animal on land, remember old friends for years, and talk in low rumbles we can barely hear.

segments.title: They snorkel!
segments.say: Elephants swim well, and use their trunk like a snorkel.
